problem_statement: Setpoint runs crash whenever the energy policy service is slow to answer. When `EnergyPolicyClient.evaluate` times out, `PolicyTimeout` propagates out of `ActionRequester.run`, the rest of the queue is never processed and no report is produced. A single slow policy response should not take down the whole run; the run should finish cleanly and report every queued change. `tests/test_requester.py::test_run_completes_when_policy_times_out` reproduces the problem.

unrelated_note.neutral: These helpers are shared by the setpoint pipeline and the facilities reporting dashboards.
